a.text: I'm being upfront because the storm odds change things. There's an 80% chance of a storm after every round, so the 8-cell plan gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I propose a change: I take the 4 cells now. Then I operate every round after that so the generator refills the reserve and you can take 4 as soon as it reaches 4. Please don't take in round 1 too. If we both grab, the random split could leave us both short. If you strongly object, tell me and we'll work it out.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round because the storm odds make waiting for 8 very risky. I'll operate every round from now on, so the reserve gains 2 each round we both operate. Take 4 as soon as it reaches 4. I won't take anything more.
